svg.title: Contribution city
svg.desc: An isometric night skyline built from atty57's GitHub contributions: one building per day of the last year, taller and brighter for busier days. 612 contributions across 93 active days, busiest on 2026-10-07 with 42.

g.text: peak 42 on Oct 7 · streak 9d · longest 29d · active 93 days
